list.name: instance
list.query: select display_name as __text, instance_pk::text as __value from control.instance_inventory where is_active order by display_name
list.label: Instance

list.name: service_group
list.query: select distinct coalesce(service_group, '(none)') as __text, coalesce(service_group, '(none)') as __value from control.instance_inventory where is_active order by 1
list.label: Service Group

targets.rawSql: select count(*) as "Active Connections" from fact.pg_activity_snapshot a join control.instance_inventory i on i.instance_pk = a.instance_pk where a.snapshot_ts = (select max(snapshot_ts) from fact.pg_activity_snapshot) and a.state = 'active' and (i.instance_pk::text in ($instance) or 'All' in ($instance)) and (i.service_group in ($service_group) or 'All' in ($service_group) or i.service_group is null)

select count(*) as "Idle in Tx" from fact.pg_activity_snapshot a join control.instance_inventory i on i.instance_pk = a.instance_pk where a.snapshot_ts = (select max(snapshot_ts) from fact.pg_activity_snapshot) and a.state = 'idle in transaction' and (i.instance_pk::text in ($instance) or 'All' in ($instance)) and (i.service_group in ($service_group) or 'All' in ($service_group) or i.service_group is null)

select case when coalesce(sum(d.session_time_ms_delta), 0) = 0 then 0 else round(coalesce(sum(d.idle_in_transaction_time_ms_delta), 0) / nullif(sum(d.session_time_ms_delta), 0) * 100, 1) end as "Idle Tx %" from fact.pg_database_delta d join control.instance_inventory i on i.instance_pk = d.instance_pk where d.sample_ts >= now() - interval '1 hour' and (i.instance_pk::text in ($instance) or 'All' in ($instance)) and (i.service_group in ($service_group) or 'All' in ($service_group) or i.service_group is null)

with latest as (select max(snapshot_ts) as ts from fact.pg_activity_snapshot) select a.instance_pk, i.display_name as instance, count(*) filter (where a.state = 'active') as active, count(*) filter (where a.state = 'idle') as idle, count(*) filter (where a.state = 'idle in transaction') as idle_in_tx, count(*) as total, round(count(*) filter (where a.state = 'idle in transaction')::numeric / nullif(count(*), 0) * 100, 1) as idle_tx_pct from fact.pg_activity_snapshot a join control.instance_inventory i on i.instance_pk = a.instance_pk cross join latest l where a.snapshot_ts = l.ts and (i.instance_pk::text in ($instance) or 'All' in ($instance)) and (i.service_group in ($service_group) or 'All' in ($service_group) or i.service_group is null) group by a.instance_pk, i.display_name order by idle_tx_pct desc

with latest as (select max(snapshot_ts) as ts from fact.pg_activity_snapshot) select a.instance_pk, i.display_name as instance, a.pid, coalesce(a.usename, '') as usename, coalesce(a.application_name, '') as application_name, a.state, round(extract(epoch from (l.ts - coalesce(a.state_change, l.ts)))) as idle_seconds from fact.pg_activity_snapshot a join control.instance_inventory i on i.instance_pk = a.instance_pk cross join latest l where a.snapshot_ts = l.ts and a.state = 'idle in transaction' and (i.instance_pk::text in ($instance) or 'All' in ($instance)) and (i.service_group in ($service_group) or 'All' in ($service_group) or i.service_group is null) order by idle_seconds desc limit 50

select $__timeGroupAlias(a.snapshot_ts, $__interval), coalesce(a.state, 'unknown') as metric, count(*) as value from fact.pg_activity_snapshot a join control.instance_inventory i on i.instance_pk = a.instance_pk where $__timeFilter(a.snapshot_ts) and (i.instance_pk::text in ($instance) or 'All' in ($instance)) and (i.service_group in ($service_group) or 'All' in ($service_group) or i.service_group is null) group by 1, coalesce(a.state, 'unknown') order by 1
